other_failure_modes.description: Categorical string columns are coerced to numeric types using `errors='coerce'`, which silently replaces all valid string categories with NaNs and destroys the feature information.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured solution utilizing LightGBM with proper time-series cross-validation and feature engineering. However, there is data leakage within the cross-validation loop because missing value imputation is calculated on the full training set prior to splitting. Furthermore, a critical bug exists where string-based categorical columns ('Holiday', 'Functioning Day') are coerced into numerics, silently destroying their data.
